paragraphs.text: Jonathan Tweet is an American game designer and author who has been involved in the development of multiple role-playing games and collectible miniatures games. Between 1990 and and 2009, Tweet worked as a designer and developer at Wizards of the Coast , mostly on products outside of Magic .
In January 1990, started as a Freelance Game Designer for Wizards of the Coast, working on games as Talislanta and Over the Edge .

Between November 1993 and March 2009, he was Senior Game Designer, working on roleplaying games (e.g., Ars Magica and Everway ), card games, miniatures games, beginner games, and online applications. Between 1998 and 2000, he led the design of the third edition of Dungeons & Dragons , a major overhaul that revitalized the D&D brand.

His other roles included Roleplaying Game Manager (1993 to 1995), Card Game Designer (1995 to 1998), D&D Game Designer (2000 to 2002), Miniatures Manager (2002 to 2005) (e.g. Dreamblade ), New Business Game Designer (2005 to 2007), and Online Game Designer (2007 to 2009).
Tweet was the author of The Mirror of Yesterday in the The Colors of Magic anthology (1999), and of The Deathbringer in the The Myths of Magic anthology (2000).
